items.html: Thus it is found that the upper three [Sefirot] of Arich Anpin sit one upon the other: Keter, and beneath it Hochma, and beneath it Bina. And they are not in the manner of lines: Keter above, and Hochma and Bina below, on the two sides of the Keter. And the essence of this correction is to be in the manner of lines, as mentioned in many places above.
